# Document fixture

`U4.21.01.pdf` is the French document "Opérateur LIRE_MAILLAGE", © EDF R&D, downloaded
unchanged from code-aster.org (`https://code-aster.org/doc/v16/man_u/u4/u4.21.01.pdf`) and
distributed under the GNU Free Documentation License (`en/docs/_src/LICENSE-GFDL-1.3.txt`), as
its own pages state. `tests/test_docs_ingest.py` ingests it and compares the result with the
committed `en/docs/_src/U4.21.01.fr.json`.
